headline: US Proposes Tariffs of Up to 18% on Malaysian Goods Following Probe
summary: The United States proposed tariffs of up to 18% on Malaysian goods following an investigation into industrial policies and manufacturing practices contributing to excess capacity.
why: Targeted trade levies alter export cost structures for emerging manufacturing hubs and influence bilateral commercial relations.

impacts.name: Malaysia
impacts.why: Proposed import tariffs create trade barriers for Malaysian manufactured goods entering the US.
